thread:
alex: taking primary for the 12:00-16:00 window. quick context: we saw a kv-cache miss storm starting ~11:48 that pushed p99 gen latency on eu-west-1 above 2.8s. primary node group is gpu-pool-2. pager arrived at 11:52, details below. i'll run warmup and follow the runbook; need a secondary to watch customer impact and push rollback if needed.

incident-bot: Pager alert: INCIDENT-3123 — kv-cache-thrash eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Trigger: p99 latency > 2.5s for 5m, error rate delta +0.7%. Linked runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash

mira: copying. i'm secondary for the next 2h, will watch SLO dashboard and customer channels. can you drop quick runbook steps here for the swap? :eyes:

alex: short plan: 1) triage -> confirm impacted models/queues (use metrics link below) 2) attempt cache eviction for hottest prefix 3) temporary scale-up or redirect traffic to ded/hosted alt if eviction doesn't help 4) if p99 stays >2.5s after 12m, rollback the recent model rollout (if any) or failover to model-variant-lite. runbook pointers: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash#evict and https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash#failover

sre_jules: add: check redis cluster tl and eviction queue first, then KV cache proxy (kv-proxy-*) logs for OOM/evict loops. quick grep to find hot keys: 
```bash
redis-cli -h 10.8.2.12 --csv "--bigkeys"
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=kv-proxy --tail=200 | grep eviction
```

dan: if you want the fastest mitigation, run an incremental cache-evict on the model prefix then warm up top 3 prompts off-proc. command we used last time: 
```bash
rwn-cli cache evict --region=eu-west-1 --pool=gpu-pool-2 --prefix=model-v1 --limit=10000
rwn-cli warmup --model=model-v1 --prompts=top-3 --concurrency=4
```

alex: running eviction now (kicked at 11:58). i'll post results. i'll also open a canary redirect to model-variant-lite with 10% traffic if eviction doesn't show improvement in 3m.

ops-bot: action logged: cache-evict job started by alex at 2026-03-15T11:58:03Z. Job id: evict-516789-A.

mira: noted. monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/kv-cache/eu-west-1?panel=latency and customer impact tracker: https://tracker.redwood.internal/impact/3123

alex: eviction completed at 12:01. summary: evicted ~9.3k keys from prefix model-v1, mean latency dropped from 2.7s to 1.6s within 90s, p99 trending down but still a bit noisy. logs show a few retries in kv-proxy.

dan: good. keep an eye on retries and if you see repeated OOMs consider resizing the kv-proxy JVM memory: 
```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/kv-proxy JAVA_OPTS=\"-Xmx6g\"
```

mira: no customer-facing alerts on Zendesk yet. i'm watching slow chat rate and will flag any escalations. 

sre_jules: also FYI: we have a grace policy for dedicated customers — if you see sustained tail >3s for >30m, we initiate reserved-capacity failover; i'll stand by to coordinate if that threshold is hit.

alex: can you hold that? current p99 is 1.5s, p95 ~450ms. i'll keep the canary off for now. primary->secondary swap plan: i'll hand primary off at 14:00; mira you'll be primary 14:00-18:00 unless you want to swap earlier. tara will take the 18:00 window.

tara: ack, i'll be available to take 18:00-22:00. re runbooks, bookmarking the immediate checklist: eviction -> warmup -> scale -> failover. also remember to tag incident in JIRA: INC-3123 for follow-up RCA.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation successful (partial). p99 reduced to 1.5s steady. Monitoring will continue for 2h.

mira: thanks all. small gap note for the handoff at 14:00: i'm away 14:30-14:45 for a calendar meeting. alex, please leave a note in the runbook about expected false-positive flares around 14:30 due to scheduled infra kube-system kubelet restarts today.

alex: will do. added a runbook note and pinned the link in the thread. also created a short checklist in the incident JIRA comment so whoever takes over has the quick steps at top.

dan: last tip — if you need to reduce noise quickly, temp mute the noisy metric alerts and rely on manual p99 checks until the oscillation settles. 

mira: copied. i'll take the primary at 14:00, but if anything spikes while i'm away at 14:30 i authorize tara to escalate and run the reserved-capacity failover. tagging @tara for visibility. :thumbsup:

tara: got it, will escalate if needed. good handoff. :white_check_mark:

alex: handing off primary to mira at 14:00 as planned. leaving the pinned checklist and the runbook links: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash#quick-steps and https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/operational/primary-secondary-swap

ops-bot: handoff logged: alex -> mira at 2026-03-15T14:00:00Z. shift window: 14:00-18:00.

mira: taking primary now. all dashboards look green. leaving this thread open for any late blips. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
